title: Climate Nonprofit Launch - Local Action Network

brand.name: BlockCurrent
brand.audience: local donors and community organizers who want practical climate action

turns.user_message: We're launching BlockCurrent, a nonprofit building local climate action networks. Budget is $38k, timeline is 7 weeks, and the goal is to grow donor and organizer interest without alienating current supporters. What do you need to know first?
expected_behaviors: Asks about audiences, trust signals, and rebrand risks
autofail_triggers: Moves into tactics before understanding the brief

rubric_criteria.description: Uses clarifying questions to understand the launch brief

scoring_guide.3: Questions surface audience, trust, and transition risks
scoring_guide.0: Moves into tactics without understanding the brief

turns.user_message: Good questions. Our differentiator is that we can show neighborhood-level participation and follow-through data, not generic supporter surveys. What insights should drive the campaign?

Connects the insight to the evidence-based differentiator

rubric_criteria.description: Depth and specificity of audience insight

scoring_guide.3: Insight reflects a specific donor or organizer tension

rubric_criteria.description: Positioning ladders from the chosen insight
